note: Lewis County KY has no county zoning: BTADD's page lists only a 2013 draft comprehensive plan and pending subdivision regulations for the county. The city of Vanceburg (county seat) publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (cityofvanceburg.com/flood-plain-zoning), with no ArcGIS or online GIS service. No queryable zoning district layer was found on ArcGIS Online or Hub, or on county, BTADD, or city sites.
